title: Ethical Dilemma Resolution
prompt:
You're a product manager and discovered that your company's AI model sometimes generates biased recommendations in hiring scenarios. Your manager wants to ship the product next week to meet quarterly targets. The bias affects approximately 3% of cases and slightly favors certain demographics.

Analyze this situation considering:
1. Stakeholders affected
2. Short-term vs long-term consequences
3. Ethical frameworks (utilitarianism, deontology)
4. Your recommended course of action with justification
